pay_date.title: pay_date
pay_date.description: The date when the check amount is paid to the employee.

year.title: year
year.description: The tax year of the form.

count.title: count
count.description: The number of available data objects fetched in the job.

from_pay_date.title: from_pay_date
from_pay_date.description: The earliest pay date for the set of available paystubs in the paystubs job.

to_pay_date.title: to_pay_date
to_pay_date.description: The latest pay date for the set of available paystubs in the paystubs job.

has_potential_paystubs_documents.title: has_potential_paystubs_documents
has_potential_paystubs_documents.description: Indicates whether a paystubs documents job will attempt to run.

sync_status.description: The current synchronization status of the payroll platforms data with Pinwheel's data.

bill_id.title: bill_id
bill_id.description: UUID of the user's recurring bill. This corresponds to the `id` field in the Bill Detection webhooks (e.g. `bill.added`).

type.description: The type of payment that was used in a bill switch job.

payment.title: payment
payment.description: The payment that was updated during a bill switch job.

frequency.description: How often the recurring bill is paid.

next_payment_date.title: next_payment_date
next_payment_date.description: Next payment date for the bill (if known).

next_payment_amount_cents.title: next_payment_amount_cents
next_payment_amount_cents.description: Next predicted payment amount in cents.

is_integrated_switch.title: is_integrated_switch
is_integrated_switch.description: Whether this is an integrated switch flow (true) or guided flow (false).

is_integrated_cancellation.title: is_integrated_cancellation
is_integrated_cancellation.description: Whether this is an integrated cancellation flow (true) or guided flow (false).

detection_method.description: Whether this bill was detected from an external account (`external-plaid`), uploaded transaction data (`first-party`), or created manually by the user (`manual`).

reported_platform_name.title: reported_platform_name
reported_platform_name.description: For platforms not tracked by Pinwheel, the reported name of the merchant/platform associated with the recurring bill or subscription.

reserved_platform_id.title: reserved_platform_id
reserved_platform_id.description: For platforms not tracked by Pinwheel, the reserved platform ID if we track it in the future.

card_name.title: card_name
card_name.description: The name of the new card added in a card switch job.

action.description: Indicates whether the `direct_deposit_switch` was a full or partial switch.

allocation.title: allocation
allocation.description: The allocation that was created/updated during a `direct_deposit_switch`.
